record.paper_title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Lower bound for properly coloured paths in graphs
record.original_question: Let G be a c-edge-coloured graph of order n with minimum monochromatic degree d = δ_mon(G) ≥ 1. Must G always contain a properly coloured path of length at least min{n - 1, 2cd}?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 5.4. Let G be a c-edge-coloured graph of order n and let d = δmon(G) ≥ 1. Then G has a PC path of length at least min{n − 1, 2cd}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a graph on $n$ vertices whose edges are coloured with $c$ colours (multiple edges of different colours between the same pair of vertices are allowed, but no two edges between the same pair share a colour). For a vertex $v\in V(G)$ and a colour $i\in\{1,\dots,c\}$, let $d^i(v)$ denote the number of edges of colour $i$ incident with $v$. Define the minimum monochromatic degree of $G$ by
$$\delta_{\mathrm{mon}}(G)=\min_{v\in V(G)}\min_{1\le i\le c} d^i(v),$$
and assume $\delta_{\mathrm{mon}}(G)\ge 1$. A path in $G$ is properly coloured (PC) if any two consecutive edges along the path have different colours, and its length is its number of edges.

Prove or disprove: every such $c$-edge-coloured graph $G$ of order $n$ contains a properly coloured path of length at least
$$\min\{\,n-1,\ 2c\,\delta_{\mathrm{mon}}(G)\,\}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search for this specific conjecture on properly coloured paths with a lower bound of min{n−1, 2c·δ_mon(G)} did not return any results indicating a proof or disproof. Related literature addresses monochromatic paths or properly coloured Hamilton paths in complete edge-coloured graphs, but no source confirming the resolution of this particular bound was found, so the status appears to remain open/unverified.

status_evidence.title: Long monochromatic paths and cycles in 2-edge-colored graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies monochromatic (not properly coloured) path bounds, not addressing the 2cd conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on coloured paths does not address the specific properly coloured path bound in question.

status_evidence.title: Properly colored cycles in edge-colored complete graphs without monochromatic triangle
status_evidence.snippet: Concerns properly coloured cycles in complete edge-coloured graphs, a different setting from the conjectured general bound.
status_evidence.claim: No evidence found that the conjecture has been resolved.
